paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the average performance (in percentage) of models on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks as a function of model size, measured by parameter count, with the x-axis displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from 70 million to 7.0 billion parameters. The y-axis, labeled "Avg. Performance (%)", is linear and spans from 0% to 80% with tick marks at 20% intervals. Three performance metrics are shown as distinct lines: Precision (red with upward-pointing triangles), Recall (blue with downward-pointing triangles), and F1-score (purple with upward-pointing triangles). The red Precision line remains relatively stable across model sizes, starting at approximately 78% at 70m parameters and ending near 72% at 7.0B parameters, with minor fluctuations. The blue Recall line increases steadily from about 10% at 70m to around 42% at 7.0B. The purple F1-score line also shows a consistent upward trend, rising from roughly 15% at 70m to approximately 55% at 7.0B. All lines are solid and marked with triangular data points at each model size interval (70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B).
